lierne_net_vaults.name: Net Vaults
lierne_net_vaults.observation: Short ribs cross and recross the vault in stars and nets, and the carved bosses where they meet glitter with gilt.

stepped_gable_brick_houses.name: Stepped-Gable Houses
stepped_gable_brick_houses.observation: Brick houses shoulder together along the canal, their stepped gables facing the water and a hoist beam at the top of each.

fan_vaults.name: Fan Vaults
fan_vaults.observation: From each pier a cone of stone ribs spreads like a fan and meets its neighbour at the crown.

hammer_beam_roofs.name: Hammer-Beam Roofs
hammer_beam_roofs.observation: Oak brackets jut from the walls to carry the arched braces, and the great hall stands seventy feet wide with no beam across it.
hammer_beam_roofs.ability_reason: Short timbers braced from the walls span halls no single beam could cross; great rooms no longer wait on giant oaks.

regulated_cesspits.name: Regulated Cesspits
regulated_cesspits.observation: The cesspit must be lined with brick and dug a set distance from any well, and only licensed night-soil men may empty it.

quadrangle_courts.name: Quadrangle Courts
quadrangle_courts.observation: Lodgings, hall and chapel stand round a square lawn; the gate is locked at nine and the scholars answer to one porter.

drainage_windmills.name: Drainage Windmills
drainage_windmills.observation: A row of windmills stands on the dike, each lifting the water a step higher, until the polder is dry enough to graze.
drainage_windmills.ability_reason: Wind lifts water out of land that lies below the sea; marsh becomes meadow, and the dikes hold what the mills win.

reversing_gear_hoists.name: Reversing Hoists
reversing_gear_hoists.observation: The ox walks one way and the stone rises; a lever shifts the gear and the empty rope comes down without turning the ox.

centerless_great_dome.name: Great Dome Without Centering
centerless_great_dome.observation: The masons lay the dome's bricks in herringbone, each course locking the last, and it rises over the great church with no timber frame beneath.
centerless_great_dome.ability_reason: Self-supporting brickwork lets a vault rise without scaffolding a forest, and builders learn that geometry can replace timber.

terracotta_facade_ornament.name: Terracotta Ornament
terracotta_facade_ornament.observation: Moulded garlands and heads come out of the kiln by the hundred and are set into brick fronts like carved stone.

courtyard_palace_block.name: Courtyard Palace
courtyard_palace_block.observation: Rough-cut stone below and smooth above, the palace turns its back on the street and opens only onto its arcaded court.

scale_plan_drawings.name: Scale Plans
scale_plan_drawings.observation: The architect draws plan, section and elevation to one scale, and the masons measure off the sheet instead of asking him daily.

classical_order_proportions.name: Classical Proportions
classical_order_proportions.observation: The column's height is so many diameters and the entablature a quarter of the column; the builder's book gives every order.

multi_flue_chimney_stacks.name: Chimney Stacks
multi_flue_chimney_stacks.observation: Every hearth's flue runs up inside the brick stack, and six chimney pots stand where smoke once seeped through the thatch.

public_loggias.name: Public Loggias
public_loggias.observation: Merchants and magistrates talk business under the open arches out of the rain, and the notary sets his table by a pillar.

mitre_lock_gates.name: Mitre Lock Gates
mitre_lock_gates.observation: Two gates meet at an angle pointing upstream; the water presses them shut, and a boy can swing them open when the levels match.
mitre_lock_gates.ability_reason: Gates that the water itself holds closed make locks quick and cheap, and canals can climb hills and carry trade inland.

street_suction_pumps.name: Street Pumps
street_suction_pumps.observation: The iron handle of the parish pump creaks at dawn as the women fill their buckets from the covered well.

tall_timber_tenements.name: Timber Tenements
tall_timber_tenements.observation: Five storeys of timber lean over the lane, a family to a room, and the stair is the only way out if fire comes.
tall_timber_tenements.social_consequence: Crowded towns can house their incomers, at the cost of fire, damp and fever in the upper rooms.

mine_airways.observation: A door underground and a fire at the upcast shaft draw fresh air down one road and foul air up the other.

ornamental_plaster_ceilings.name: Plaster Ceilings
ornamental_plaster_ceilings.observation: The plasterers run ribs across the parlour ceiling and hang pendants where they cross, all from moulds cut by the master.

pile_grid_foundations.name: Pile Grid Foundations
pile_grid_foundations.observation: Thousands of pine piles are rammed into the mud in rows, and the houses on the quay stand on them as on a buried forest.

gable_hoist_warehouses.name: Gable Hoist Warehouses
gable_hoist_warehouses.observation: Grain sacks swing up from the barge on the gable hoist and in through the loft doors five storeys above the water.

open_well_staircases.name: Grand Staircases
open_well_staircases.observation: The stair climbs round an open well with a landing at every turn, lit from a lantern in the roof.

symmetrical_villas.name: Symmetrical Villas
symmetrical_villas.observation: The villa's two wings mirror each other round a porticoed hall, and the farm buildings hide behind the kitchen garden.

fountain_squares.name: Fountain Squares
fountain_squares.observation: The paved square before the town hall has a fountain at its centre, and the water carriers fill their casks at its basin.

merchants_exchange_hall.name: Exchange Hall
merchants_exchange_hall.observation: At noon the merchants gather in the exchange's arcaded court, each nation at its own pillar.

elliptical_arch_bridges.name: Elliptical Arch Bridges
elliptical_arch_bridges.observation: Three flat arches carry the bridge across the river, and barges pass beneath without lowering their masts.
elliptical_arch_bridges.ability_reason: Flatter arches span wide rivers on fewer piers; bridges stop damming the floods and let the boats through.

truss_timber_bridges.name: Truss Bridges
truss_timber_bridges.observation: Triangles of timber carry the bridge across the gorge in one span, and no pier stands in the torrent.

bridge_wheel_waterworks.name: Bridge Waterworks
bridge_wheel_waterworks.observation: Wheels under the bridge's arches turn with the tide and pump river water up into the city's lead mains.
bridge_wheel_waterworks.ability_reason: The river's own current pumps water to the houses, and piped supply no longer depends on a spring above the town.

cut_through_avenues.name: Cut-Through Avenues
cut_through_avenues.observation: The prince's surveyors drive a straight avenue through the old quarter, and pilgrims walk from one great square to the next.
cut_through_avenues.social_consequence: The city gains broad views and quick passage; the families of the demolished lanes are scattered.

flushing_privy_cistern.name: Flushing Privy
flushing_privy_cistern.observation: Pull the handle and water from the cistern above washes the pan clean; the courtier who built one has had it copied in two houses.

fireproof_record_vaults.name: Fireproof Record Vaults
fireproof_record_vaults.observation: The realm's rolls are kept in brick-vaulted rooms with iron doors and no timber anywhere a spark could catch.

uniform_facade_squares.name: Uniform Squares
uniform_facade_squares.observation: Every house round the square has the same arcade, the same windows and the same roofline, as the charter demanded.

contour_water_cut.name: Contour Water Cut
contour_water_cut.observation: The new cut winds forty miles along the hillside, falling a few inches to the mile, and brings spring water to the town's round pond.

tree_lined_promenades.name: Promenades
tree_lined_promenades.observation: Where the old ramparts stood, four rows of limes shade a gravel walk, and the whole town takes the air on a holiday.

drained_lake_polders.name: Drained Lake Polders
drained_lake_polders.observation: A ring dike is thrown round the lake, forty mills pump for four years, and a new village is laid out on the old lake bed.
drained_lake_polders.ability_reason: Whole lakes become farmland, and the realm gains land without conquest.

scagliola_stucco.name: Scagliola
scagliola_stucco.observation: Plaster mixed with glue and colour is polished until it passes for marble, and a column costs a tenth of the stone.

mansard_roofs.name: Mansard Roofs
mansard_roofs.observation: The roof breaks steeply at the eaves, and the attic under it becomes a row of rooms with dormer windows.

fen_drainage_cuts.name: Fen Drainage Cuts
fen_drainage_cuts.observation: A straight cut twenty miles long carries the fen water to the sea, and the sluices keep the tide out.
fen_drainage_cuts.ability_reason: Great straight drains turn seasonal marsh into ploughland, and the realm's granary grows by whole districts.
fen_drainage_cuts.social_consequence: The drainers gain new farmland; the fenmen lose their fish, fowl and reed, and the drained peat begins to shrink.

alternating_bond_brickwork.name: Alternating Bond
alternating_bond_brickwork.observation: Headers and stretchers alternate in every course, and the rubbed brick arches over the windows are cut to a hair's joint.

canal_ring_quarters.name: Canal Ring Quarters
canal_ring_quarters.observation: The new quarters ring the old town in three canals, with quays for the barges and elms along the brick-paved streets.

water_tower_cisterns.name: Water Towers
water_tower_cisterns.observation: The force pump drives water up into the lead tank in the tower, and from there it runs down to the fountains and kitchens.

axial_palace_gardens.name: Axial Palace
axial_palace_gardens.observation: Palace, forecourt and garden fall on one line to the horizon, and the court lodges in the wings at the prince's command.
axial_palace_gardens.ability_reason: A seat of court built on one axis gathers the nobility under the prince's eye; state and spectacle become one place.
axial_palace_gardens.social_consequence: The court glitters, the nobles are tamed by residence, and the realm pays for the fountains in taxes and labor drafts.

cast_iron_water_mains.name: Cast-Iron Mains
cast_iron_water_mains.observation: Cast-iron pipes flanged and bolted together carry the fountain water under pressure, where wooden mains would burst.
cast_iron_water_mains.ability_reason: Iron pipes hold pressure and last for generations, so water can be sent uphill and far.

fire_rebuilding_acts.name: Fire Rebuilding Acts
fire_rebuilding_acts.observation: No timber fronts, brick walls of set thickness, four classes of house by the width of the street: the burned city is rebuilt to the act.

street_lantern_lighting.name: Street Lanterns
street_lantern_lighting.observation: Oil lanterns hang over the streets from dusk to midnight, and the lamplighter's ladder is a familiar sight at evening.

sash_windows.name: Sash Windows
sash_windows.observation: The lower sash slides up on its cords and hidden weights, and the room airs without the window swinging into the street.

lock_staircases.name: Lock Staircases
lock_staircases.observation: Eight locks climb the hillside in one flight, each chamber's upper gate the next one's lower.

canal_tunnels.name: Canal Tunnels
canal_tunnels.observation: Boatmen lie on their backs and walk the barge through the dark tunnel with their feet on the roof.

water_lifting_machine.name: Great Water Machine
water_lifting_machine.observation: Fourteen wheels in the river drive two hundred pumps up three stages of the hill, and the palace fountains play for the court.
water_lifting_machine.ability_reason: The river is made to climb a hill: machinery can lift water where no gravity would carry it.

mirror_gallery_halls.name: Hall of Mirrors
mirror_gallery_halls.observation: Seventeen arched mirrors face seventeen windows, and the candlelight of the ball is doubled down the gallery.

speculative_terrace_rows.name: Speculative Terraces
speculative_terrace_rows.observation: The builder leases a field, runs up forty brick houses to one plan and sells them before the plaster is dry.

heated_orangeries.name: Heated Orangeries
heated_orangeries.observation: Behind the south-facing glass, flues in the back wall keep the orange trees alive through the frost.

vaulted_brick_sewers.name: Brick Sewers
vaulted_brick_sewers.observation: A man can walk upright in the brick sewer under the high street, which carries the storm water and the house drains down to the river.

turnpike_trust_roads.name: Turnpike Trusts
turnpike_trust_roads.observation: The trust sets a gate and a toll house every ten miles, and the tolls pay for gravel, ditches and a surveyor.
turnpike_trust_roads.ability_reason: Tolls pay for roads the parishes never kept, and coaches and wagons can run to a timetable.

enclosed_wet_docks.name: Wet Docks
enclosed_wet_docks.observation: Behind the dock gates the ships ride afloat at low tide, unloading straight onto the quays and into the bonded warehouses.
enclosed_wet_docks.ability_reason: Ships held afloat whatever the tide load and unload in days, and the port can handle a whole fleet at once.

bridge_road_engineer_corps.name: Bridge and Road Corps
bridge_road_engineer_corps.observation: The crown's engineers survey every royal road, plan every bridge and check the contractors' work with level and rod.
bridge_road_engineer_corps.ability_reason: A standing corps of engineers makes roads and bridges a service of the state, and keeps skill and standards across generations.

culverted_town_streams.name: Culverted Streams
culverted_town_streams.observation: The stinking brook is arched over with brick, and a street now runs on top where the tanners' ditch once lay.

street_name_plates.name: Street Name Plates
street_name_plates.observation: Each corner bears a painted plate with the street's name, and strangers need no longer ask their way.

steam_waterworks.name: Steam Waterworks
steam_waterworks.observation: The engine house by the river pumps day and night, and water reaches the upper streets that no wheel could serve.

stucco_rendered_facades.name: Stucco Facades
stucco_rendered_facades.observation: The brick front is rendered in stucco, lined out in false joints and painted to pass for stone.

house_pattern_books.name: House Pattern Books
house_pattern_books.observation: The builder opens his pattern book at plate thirty and gives the carpenter the doorcase, cornice and stair, all to measure.

bridge_pier_caissons.name: Pier Caissons
bridge_pier_caissons.observation: A great timber box is floated to the pier site; the masons build inside it, and it sinks as the stone rises until it settles on the dredged bed.
bridge_pier_caissons.ability_reason: Piers founded in deep water make lasting bridges possible across the great rivers.

horse_pile_drivers.name: Horse Pile Drivers
horse_pile_drivers.observation: A horse walking round the gin lifts the iron ram, and it drops on the pile with a crash heard across the river.

iron_flue_stoves.name: Iron Flue Stoves
iron_flue_stoves.observation: The iron stove heats the room from one armful of wood, and its flue carries the smoke away through the wall.

dome_iron_chains.name: Dome Iron Chains
dome_iron_chains.observation: Iron chains are forged round the cracked dome in rings, and the cracks stop spreading.

bridge_road_engineering_school.name: Bridge and Road School
bridge_road_engineering_school.observation: The young engineers study mechanics and drawing through the winter, and in summer they survey roads under the corps' inspectors.

building_line_regulation.name: Building Lines
building_line_regulation.observation: The surveyor stakes the line, and no new house front may stand one inch forward of it.

lightning_conductors.name: Lightning Rods
lightning_conductors.observation: A pointed iron rod on the steeple runs down to damp earth, and the powder magazine beside it no longer fears the storm.

braced_timber_cage_walls.name: Braced Timber Cages
braced_timber_cage_walls.observation: After the earthquake, new houses are built on a cage of crossed timbers that sways instead of falling.

concrete_mix_design.observation: The engineer tests lime from each quarry by whether it sets under water, and mixes his harbour concrete by measured parts.

dovetailed_rock_lighthouse.name: Rock Lighthouse
dovetailed_rock_lighthouse.observation: Each granite block is dovetailed into the next, so the tower on the wave-swept rock stands as one stone, and its light shows twenty miles out.
dovetailed_rock_lighthouse.ability_reason: Stones locked together resist the sea: lights stand on the most dangerous rocks, and ships can keep the sea at night.

puddled_clay_canal_lining.name: Puddled Clay Lining
puddled_clay_canal_lining.observation: Diggers and cattle tread wet clay into the canal bed until it holds water like a pot.

canal_river_aqueducts.name: Canal Aqueducts
canal_river_aqueducts.observation: The barges sail across the river on a stone aqueduct forty feet above the water.
canal_river_aqueducts.ability_reason: Canals can cross valleys on the level, and a network can join rivers instead of following them.

house_numbering.name: House Numbers
house_numbering.observation: Every door is numbered, odd on one side and even on the other, and the letter carrier finds the house without asking.

curbed_footways.name: Curbed Footways
curbed_footways.observation: A raised stone pavement with a curb keeps walkers above the mud and out of the way of the carts.

planned_new_town_grid.name: Planned New Town
planned_new_town_grid.observation: Across the valley from the old town rise three straight streets and two squares, and the gentry move over the bridge.
planned_new_town_grid.social_consequence: The well-off move to clean new streets, and the old town is left to the poor and its crowded closes.

crescent_terraces.name: Crescent Terraces
crescent_terraces.observation: Thirty houses sweep round a green in one curved front, as if they were a single palace.

cylinder_boring.observation: The boring bar, held at both ends, cuts the engine cylinder true to within the thickness of a thin coin.

layered_stone_road_beds.name: Layered Stone Roads
layered_stone_road_beds.observation: Stone broken small enough to fit a man's mouth is laid in layers on a cambered bed with ditches either side, and the wheels pack it hard.
layered_stone_road_beds.ability_reason: Dry, well-drained stone roads carry coaches in all weathers, and journey times fall by half.

ministry_office_block.name: Ministry Offices
ministry_office_block.observation: The ministries move from rented houses into one great block of offices by the river, with a clerk's desk in every window.
ministry_office_block.ability_reason: Departments under one roof can coordinate; the realm's business runs from files and not from ministers' households.

s_trap_water_closets.name: S-Bend Closets
s_trap_water_closets.observation: The pipe bends in an S below the pan, and the water held in the bend stops the sewer air rising into the house.

cast_iron_arch_bridge.name: Cast-Iron Bridge
cast_iron_arch_bridge.observation: Five cast-iron ribs, jointed like carpentry, spring across the gorge, and people come from far away to walk on the iron bridge.
cast_iron_arch_bridge.ability_reason: Iron shows it can carry a bridge: here is the material for spans greater than timber or stone will allow.

concrete_formwork_systems.observation: Reusable plank shutters are clamped on either side, the lime concrete rammed in, and the shutters moved up for the next course.

precision_machinery.observation: A lathe with true iron slides, a screw feed and hardened bearings cuts parts that fit without the filer's endless trying.
precision_machinery.ability_reason: Machines that guide the cutter truly let every part be made to measure, so engines and instruments can be built to fit.

rubble_mound_breakwaters.name: Rubble Breakwaters
rubble_mound_breakwaters.observation: Barges drop a mile of broken stone into the roadstead until a long mound breaks the sea and the fleet can shelter behind it.

road_rolling_maintenance.name: Road Rolling
road_rolling_maintenance.observation: A heavy roller drawn by four horses packs the new stone, and the water cart follows to lay the dust.

iron_framed_fireproof_mill.name: Iron-Framed Mill
iron_framed_fireproof_mill.observation: Brick arches spring between cast-iron beams on iron columns, and not a board in the mill could catch from a lamp.
iron_framed_fireproof_mill.ability_reason: Iron frames and brick vaults make buildings that cannot burn, and mills can rise many floors high.

narrow_throat_fireplace.name: Narrow-Throat Fireplace
narrow_throat_fireplace.observation: The fireplace is narrowed at the throat and its cheeks angled outward, so the room is warmed and the smoke goes up.

pressure_pipe_jointing.observation: Iron pipes are flanged and bolted on a lead gasket, or socketed and caulked, and the main holds under pressure.
